name: aetherx-mcp
description: Predictive port congestion signals for global trade, supply chain and quantitative finance.
long_description:
Exposes the Aether-X Port Congestion Oracle to MCP-compatible agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, custom LLM agents).

Tools:
- `get_port_risk`: predictive congestion signal for a single port (UN/LOCODE).
- `get_ports_risk`: scan a portfolio of ports in parallel.
- `list_supported_ports`: list the 15 pre-seeded global ports.

Covers 15 major ports including Santos, Shanghai, Rotterdam, Singapore, Los Angeles and Hamburg. Forecasts and risk scores are produced by the Aether-X engine and served over the production API.

tools.name: get_port_risk
tools.description: Return the predictive congestion signal for a single port.

tools.name: get_ports_risk
tools.description: Return congestion signals for several ports in parallel.

tools.name: list_supported_ports
tools.description: List the 15 ports pre-seeded in the oracle (id, name, country).

rapidapi_key.title: RapidAPI Key
rapidapi_key.description: RapidAPI key for metered access to the Aether-X Port Congestion Oracle. Optional; without it the server calls the public API directly.
